system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 1 hour, 12 Spell Uses. Lasts: 2 hours. Summons a lesser fae similar to an Otherling with pure black eyes, terrifyingly seductive. It starts fucking everyone in sight, switching body shape as needed. A great distraction. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
